notes:
Summary/CRM notes:
- POC history: started Jul '25. Focus: replace brittle internal ranking + power support chat with embeddings + reranking.
- What we delivered: dedicated test pool, sample reranker pipeline, latency baseline + token cost estimates.
- What stalled it: Milestone #2 (integration tests) missed in Nov '25 — engineering team pulled to higher-priority infra project.
- Security: Sec team insisted on company-managed KMS + EU data residency for some clients. They are risk-averse; asked for SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence and longer retention audit trails. We provided FAQ, but they said "we need HSM/KMS in our VPC".
- Procurement: During pause they ran a bake-off. Feedback: competitor X offered a hosted turnkey solution with faster time-to-value (lower integration lift) — favored by product ops.
- Internal dynamics: Original champion (Sr Product Eng, Aaron Holloway) left in Dec; no clear successor. C-level sympathetic but conservative on spend (Q4 hiring/budget freeze).
- AE notes: multiple stalled outreach attempts (Gmail threads listed), last direct activity 2026-01-28. Product says they'd re-open if we can show on-prem proof-of-concept or a smaller scoped POC that requires zero engineering from their side.
- Quote from product lead: "If it needs our eng time, we can't commit — we need a plug-and-play eval."
- Current status: POC paused; classified as high priority to re-open but low likelihood before Q3 hiring window.
- Suggested next steps: 1) propose 4-week zero-engineering POC (hosted sandbox + synthetic data), 2) offer security deep-dive with our infra/security SME and a KMS design sketch, 3) get commitment from procurement on a small paid pilot to keep momentum.
- Adjacent artifacts: pricing deck, security FAQ, POC runbook in drive.
- Risk: customer likely to default to simpler hosted vendor if we don't reduce integration burden.
